standard_prerequisites: the Extensionality axiom for set equality
core_obligations: Derive from Pairing and Union that for any sets a and b the singleton {a}, the binary union a union b, and the Kuratowski ordered pair (a,b) all exist
proof_roadmap: Singleton: Pairing gives {a,a}, which equals {a} by Extensionality
Binary union: Pairing gives {a,b}; the Union axiom applied to it yields a union b
Ordered pair: {a} exists by the singleton step and {a,b} by Pairing; pairing these two gives the Kuratowski pair {{a},{a,b}}
difficulty_reason: Three short axiom applications; each clause is one or two lines and fully written out in the source.
